description: 24 independently graded queries over the same frozen 29-job India ATS snapshot. Relevance: 2=direct match, 1=useful/adjacent match, absent=irrelevant. Labels were audited from job descriptions rather than generated by BoardForge.

grading.0: irrelevant or too weakly related; represented by absence from relevance_grades
grading.1: useful adjacent role with substantive JD evidence for the intent

corpus.note: Raw public job descriptions are intentionally not duplicated in the repository. Generate or retain the frozen snapshot with snapshot-eval-corpus.
